definitions.explanation: Taking a photo or filming a scene again because the first attempt was unsatisfactory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{撮|と}り{直|なお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{願|ねが}いした→お願いする：05654_onegaisuru⟧。
examples.english: I asked for a retake of the photo.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つぶって→つぶる：29078_tsuburu⟧しまった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{撮|と}り{直|なお}しになった。
examples.english: I blinked, so we had to retake it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{撮|と}り{直|なお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{要求|ようきゅう}して→要求する：25533_youkyuusuru⟧、⟦スタッフ→スタッフ：11046_sutaffu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疲|つか}れ→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧⟦{切|き}っていた→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: The director demanded retakes over and over, and the staff were exhausted.

notes:
{撮|と}り{直|なお}し is the noun form of the verb ⟦{撮|と}り{直|なお}す→撮り直す：25509_torinaosu⟧ (to retake, to reshoot). It follows the common ～{直|なお}し pattern meaning "re-doing" something.

FORMS:
⟦{撮|と}る→撮る：00760_toru⟧ (to take a photo/film) + {直|なお}す (to redo) → {撮|と}り{直|なお}し (a retake)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {撮|と}り{直|なお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to ask for a retake
- {撮|と}り{直|なお}し⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to result in a retake
- ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{撮|と}り{直|なお}し: many retakes

USAGE:
Used for both casual photography (redoing a snapshot) and professional film/video production. In film contexts, retakes can number in the dozens for demanding directors.

SIMILAR ～{直|なお}し WORDS:
- {書|か}き{直|なお}し: rewrite
- ⟦{作|つく}り{直|なお}し→作り直す：20924_tsukurinaosu⟧: remaking
- やり{直|なお}し: redo, start over
